question: Four years ago today, Gareth Bale's penalty vs. the USA was Wales' first World Cup goal in 64 years. In 1958, the last time Wales had played at a World Cup, who knocked them out?
question_short: Wales waited 64 years between World Cup games. Who knocked them out in 1958?
answer_detail: Brazil beat Wales 1-0 in the 1958 quarterfinals in Gothenburg. The lone goal was Pelé's first ever at a World Cup, making him the tournament's youngest scorer. Brazil went on to win the title.
answer_short: Pelé's goal was his first ever at a World Cup, and Brazil went on to win it.
